# OMB-1 Federal AI Use Case Inventory

## Project Context
Centralized repository for federal agency AI use case inventories per EO 13960 and OMB M-24-10.
- 41 federal agencies reporting
- 2,133+ AI use cases tracked
- 351 rights/safety-impacting use cases

## Tech Stack
- Python 3.x (standard library preferred)
- Data formats: CSV, YAML, XLS
- No web frameworks (data repository focus)
- Keep dependencies minimal

## Project Structure
```
data/          - Source CSV/XLS files (NEVER modify directly)
validation/    - Data quality tools and reports
.claude/       - Project configuration
```

## Development Rules (GSD-Compatible)

### Atomic Workflow
1. Max 2-3 tasks per session
2. Commit after each task: `{type}(validation): {description}`
3. Test before committing: Run quality_checker.py
4. Keep context <50%: Load only relevant files

### Data Integrity
- NEVER modify files in data/ directory
- data_dictionary.yaml is source of truth for schema
- Validate all changes against data dictionary
- Maintain >95% completeness score

### Code Standards
- validation/ - All quality checking code
- Use type hints for public methods
- Keep scripts runnable: python3 validation/script.py
- Document with docstrings, not excessive comments

### Deviation Rules
**Auto-fix:**
- Data validation bugs
- Missing required field checks
- Report formatting issues
- Security vulnerabilities

**Ask first:**
- Schema changes to data_dictionary.yaml
- New data source integrations
- Breaking changes to validation API
- Major architectural decisions

**Log for later:**
- Report enhancements
- Additional statistics
- Performance optimizations

## Quality Gates
- Run `python3 validation/quality_checker.py` before commits
- Completeness score must stay >95%
- All required fields validated
- Reports must be human-readable markdown

## Git Workflow
- Branch: claude/[task-description]-[id]
- Commits: feat/fix/docs/refactor/test
- Push to designated branch when complete
- Never force push to main

## When Using GSD Commands
- `/gsd:new-project` - Use for major new features only
- `/gsd:plan-phase` - Break work into validation/reporting/integration
- `/gsd:execute-plan` - Auto-execute with confidence (tested workflow)
- `/gsd:rollback` - Safe to use, we have clean atomic commits

## Project-Specific Context
When working on validation:
- Load: validation/data_dictionary.yaml
- Reference: First 10 rows of CSV for structure
- Skip: Full CSV unless explicitly needed (1757 rows)

When adding statistics:
- Match README.md format and structure
- Agency counts, use case totals, rights-impacting counts
- Top agencies table format

## Success Criteria
- Code runs without external dependencies
- Reports are accurate and actionable
- Data integrity maintained
- Git history tells clear story
